text: Make prioritization fall back to connected uncommitted work
description: When an active phase contains open mission containers but no open leaf, get_prioritized_ideas must rank connected uncommitted open ideas rather than returning only the root and forcing a second discovery workflow. Report the fallback scope and counts explicitly; preserve normal phase ranking when an open committed leaf exists.

reflections.context: The infinite-loop entry tool returned only the root ASI mission although graph_hygiene reported 52 connected uncommitted open ideas.
reflections.outcome: get_prioritized_ideas now detects whether the selected phase has an open committed leaf. If not, it ranks connected uncommitted open ideas, labels selectionScope=connected-uncommitted-fallback, and reports openLeafIdeas and uncommittedFallbackIdeas diagnostics. Added an end-to-end MCP regression test.
reflections.effectiveness: The new regression subtest passed and the MCP TypeScript build plus git diff check pass. The node test runner retains a known open handle after reporting success and was terminated manually; no dev server was touched.
reflections.lesson: Making hidden work queryable is insufficient for autonomy: the primary selection primitive itself needs a safe fallback when a phase contains only strategic containers.

status.comment: Implemented and internally verified; awaiting Felix's acceptance. The already-running MCP process must be reconnected naturally before live behavior reflects the rebuilt code.
